abs.name: ABS (Anti-lock Braking System)
abs.hint: Assets: ABS ECU (root group container, default), Wheel Speed Sensors (default, child of ABS ECU — four hall-effect sensors FL/FR/RL/RR), Hydraulic Control Unit (default, child of ABS ECU — solenoid valves and pump motor), CAN Transceiver (default, child of ABS ECU), OBD-II Interface (default, child of ABS ECU — UDS diagnostic access), Code Flash (default, inside MCU group — ABS firmware and braking algorithms), Data Flash (default, inside MCU group — calibration parameters and NVM config), Keys (default, inside MCU group — cryptographic seed-key and secure boot keys), Certificates (default, inside MCU group — X.509 ECU auth certificates), Debug Port (default, inside MCU group — JTAG/SWD, must be locked in production), Brake Pressure Data (data node, child of ABS ECU), Diagnostic Data (data node, child of ABS ECU — DTCs and freeze frames), Vehicle CAN Bus (external, default), ECM Engine Control Module (external, default). The 'ABS ECU' is the root group container; inside it are Wheel Speed Sensors, Hydraulic Control Unit, CAN Transceiver, OBD-II Interface, Brake Pressure Data (data), Diagnostic Data (data), and an unnamed MCU subgroup containing Code Flash, Data Flash, Keys, Certificates, and Debug Port. Edges: PWM_Input (MCU group↔Wheel Speed Sensors), PWM_Control (MCU group↔Hydraulic Control Unit), CAN_Internal (MCU group↔CAN Transceiver), UDS_Diag (MCU group↔OBD-II Interface), CAN_Bus (CAN Transceiver↔Vehicle CAN Bus), Vehicle_CAN (Vehicle CAN Bus↔ECM), Computes (MCU group→Brake Pressure Data), Logs (MCU group→Diagnostic Data), Reads_DTC (OBD-II Interface↔Diagnostic Data).

bms.name: BMS (Battery Management System)
bms.hint: Assets: BatteryPack (external, default), CellMonitoring (default), IO and Analog (default), Code Flash (default, inside MCU group), Data Flash (default, inside MCU group), Keys (default, inside MCU group), Certificates (default, inside MCU group), Debug Port (default, inside MCU group), CAN Transceiver (default), ICD Shunt CAN (default), SoC (data node), SoH (data node), Vehicle System (external, default), Cloud (external, default). The 'Battery Management System' is a group container; inside it is an unnamed MCU subgroup containing Code Flash, Data Flash, Keys, Certificates, and Debug Port. Edges: SPI (CellMonitoring↔BatteryPack), SPI_CellMonitor (MCU group↔CellMonitoring), IO (IO and Analog↔BatteryPack), IO_PINS (MCU group↔IO and Analog), CAN1 (MCU group↔ICD Shunt CAN), CAN2 (MCU group↔CAN Transceiver), ICD_Data (ICD Shunt CAN↔BatteryPack), Vehicle CAN (Vehicle System↔CAN Transceiver), Internet (Vehicle System↔Cloud).

tcu.name: TCU (Telematics Control Unit)
tcu.hint: Assets: Modem firmware, SIM/eSIM credentials, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth stacks, Telematics cloud APIs, OTA update client, Security tokens/credentials, CAN/Ethernet gateway routing, Telemetry logs.

telematics.name: Telematics System
telematics.hint: Assets: Vehicle-cloud APIs, OTA servers, Security certificates, Authentication tokens, Telemetry storage, Data synchronization protocols.

ecs.name: ECU - General (Electronic Control Unit)
ecs.hint: Assets: MCU/SoC, Firmware flash, RAM content, Bootloader, Secure boot keys, Debug ports (JTAG/UART), Network interfaces (CAN, Ethernet), Diagnostic interface.

ecm.name: ECM / Powertrain (Engine Control Module)
ecm.hint: Assets: ECU MCU, CAN bus messages, OBD-II diagnostic services, Firmware, Calibration files (Engine maps), Variant coding.

adas.name: ADAS ECU
adas.hint: Assets: Perception software, ADAS ECU MCU, CAN/Ethernet messages, Neural network model weights, Calibration data, OTA client, V2X interface.

infotainment.name: Infotainment Head Unit
infotainment.hint: Assets: Infotainment ECU (root group container, default), Display Unit (default, child of Infotainment Head Unit — touchscreen HMI, I2C/MIPI-DSI), Audio Amplifier (default, child of Infotainment Head Unit — I2S digital audio), Bluetooth Module (default, child of Infotainment Head Unit — HCI UART link, BT/BLE stack), Wi-Fi Module (default, child of Infotainment Head Unit — SDIO link, 802.11ac), USB Interface (default, child of Infotainment Head Unit — USB 2.0 host, CarPlay/Android Auto), Microphone (default, child of Infotainment Head Unit — ADC line-in, voice capture), Rear Camera Input (default, child of Infotainment Head Unit — MIPI-CSI2 video), CAN Transceiver (default, child of Infotainment Head Unit — vehicle network gateway), Code Flash (default, inside MCU group — IVI OS firmware and application code), Data Flash (default, inside MCU group — calibration, config NVM, user settings), Keys (default, inside MCU group — TLS/OTA signing keys, Bluetooth link keys), Certificates (default, inside MCU group — X.509 TLS client cert, secure boot cert), Debug Port (default, inside MCU group — JTAG/UART, must be disabled in production), User Profiles (data node, child of Infotainment Head Unit — PII: driver preferences, contacts, call history), Navigation Data (data node, child of Infotainment Head Unit — GPS routes, POI history, location logs), Vehicle CAN Bus (external, default), Smartphone (external, default), Cloud Backend (external, default), OBD-II Port (external, default). The 'Infotainment Head Unit' is the root group container; inside it are Display Unit, Audio Amplifier, Bluetooth Module, Wi-Fi Module, USB Interface, Microphone, Rear Camera Input, CAN Transceiver, User Profiles (data), Navigation Data (data), and an unnamed MCU subgroup containing Code Flash, Data Flash, Keys, Certificates, and Debug Port. Edges: I2C (MCU group↔Display Unit), I2S (MCU group↔Audio Amplifier), HCI (MCU group↔Bluetooth Module), SDIO (MCU group↔Wi-Fi Module), USB2 (MCU group↔USB Interface), ADC_MIC (MCU group↔Microphone), MIPI_CSI (MCU group↔Rear Camera Input), CAN_IVI (MCU group↔CAN Transceiver), Vehicle_CAN (CAN Transceiver↔Vehicle CAN Bus), HTTPS (Wi-Fi Module↔Cloud Backend), BT_Profile (Bluetooth Module↔Smartphone), OBD_UDS (OBD-II Port↔CAN Transceiver).
